zh: 拓扑校验失败：{0} 的末端接到了 {1} 的中间，但这里还没有建立共同连接点。 可能原因：当前数据把这里记录成“一面连续长墙 + 一面在中途结束的墙”。几何上看起来已经接触，但拓扑图里没有共享节点；这通常来自识图时把 T 型交接处的主墙识别成了一整段。 建议修正：① 如果原图确实是 T 型连接，把 {2} 在交点处分成两段，让三段墙共用同一个连接点；② 如果这里本应是墙角，把 {3} 的末端移动到 {4} 的真实端点；③ 如果其中一段是误识别墙，对照原图后删除误识别墙。 {5}
en: Topology validation failed: The end of {0} connects to the middle of {1}, but no shared junction point exists here. Possible cause: Currently recorded as "one continuous long wall + one wall ending halfway". Geometrically they appear to touch, but there is no shared node in the topology graph; this usually happens when the recognition treats the main wall at a T-junction as a single segment. Suggested fix: ① If it is indeed a T-junction in the original drawing, split {2} into two segments at the intersection so all three wall segments share the same junction node; ② If this was meant to be a corner, move the end of {3} to the actual endpoint of {4}; ③ If one segment was misrecognized, check against the original drawing and delete it. {5}

Possible cause: Door/window extends beyond wall segment, room outline self-intersects, or some entities lack valid associations. Suggested fix: Locate the affected door/window/room in the floorplan, compare with the original drawing, and adjust position, dimensions, or associated walls. Technical info: {0}

Possible cause: Recognition drew walls that should split at the intersection as two complete intersecting walls. Suggested fix: If they actually meet in the original drawing, split both walls at the intersection and share a junction node; if they do not intersect, move the misrecognized wall endpoints. {2}
